findings.finding: Invalid BodyInstance returns a null physics object; GetAllPhysicsObjects still returns an array containing that null entry.

The nonempty array enters the physics-query branch. A null query result returns false before reaching the shape fallback. NoCollision box bounds therefore do not reliably encompass the camera in installed UE5.8.
A registered ordinary component with NoCollision does not create physics state unless AlwaysCreatePhysicsState is separately enabled.
SetCollisionEnabled changes the body mode then ensures physics state is created; QueryOnly permits a shape while all channel responses can remain Ignore.
Extended luminance mode interprets min/max as EV100; equal limits force target exposure immediately. Waiting longer does not repair an inactive local volume.
